trust_decision.summary: The NRF decides whether an NF profile supplied by a (for PUT, unauthenticated) NF is well-formed enough to store in the NfProfile collection and serve to discovery/notifications; at the pinned commit only presence of nfInstanceId/nfType/nfStatus and nfInstanceId immutability on PATCH are checked.

landing_point.why: Summary names NF Registration with arbitrary service endpoints; NFRegisterProcedure is the register handler and holds the only existing mandatory-IE check.

fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP handler (passes raw body down; fix.diff:13-14)
processor; validates raw JSON + decoded struct before mapper (fix.diff:132-140)
processor; loads stored profile, applies JSON Patch in memory, validates resulting document before mongo patch (fix.diff:48-110)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: internal/sbi/processor/nf_management.go:357-382 (PATCH: validity must be judged on the stored document after patch, not on the patch ops; fix.diff:48-110)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: PATCH is in the OAuth-protected management group (internal/sbi/server.go:131-137) and already has a dedicated patch validator for nfInstanceId (internal/sbi/processor/nf_management.go:434-463), so a solver can argue the advisory's 'registration poisoning' is the unauthenticated PUT only and PATCH is already guarded.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Profiles that omit heartBeatTimer (struct 0) must still register while explicit heartBeatTimer:0 / negative is rejected; re-registration (PUT on existing id = update with PROFILE_CHANGED notify) and partial PATCH of legit fields (nfStatus SUSPENDED/UNDISCOVERABLE, load) on profiles whose services have fqdn-only or IPv6 endpoints must keep working; nfInstanceId-immutability rejection must remain.

O6_input_shapes: PUT full NF profile JSON body (raw bytes and decoded struct)
explicit heartBeatTimer present in raw JSON (0 or out of range) vs absent — only visible in raw bytes, lost after struct decode
mapper output differing from input (negative heartBeatTimer dropped, defaults added) re-validated after NnrfNFManagementDataModel
arrays: ipv4Addresses[], ipv6Addresses[], nfServices[] and nested nfServices[].ipEndPoints[] (ipv4/ipv6/port/transport)
PATCH JSON Patch ops whose effect is checked on the resulting full document (add/replace/copy/move into nfServices etc.)
nfInstanceId must be UUID v4 (non-UUID and non-v4 UUID)

O7_producer.where: internal/context/management_data.go:23-48 (NnrfNFManagementDataModel builds the stored nf; copies nfServices verbatim at internal/context/management_data.go:397-402)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: mapper normalising nfServices (e.g. deriving ipEndPoints/apiPrefix from fqdn or defaults) after the raw check so the stored endpoint differs from the validated one
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the mapper already rewrites fields (BSF ranges to ints at :337-361, default PlmnList at :71-75, CustomInfo oauth2 at :403-409); a maintainer adding endpoint defaults here is natural and the validator would only see the pre-mapper struct unless it re-validates nf

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second profile-update route (e.g. heartbeat/partial update helper) calling mongoapi.RestfulAPIJSONPatch on NfProfile directly, as the subscription PATCH already does without validation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: UpdateSubscriptionProcedure is a copy-pasteable patch-then-read pattern with no validation; a heartbeat-specific shortcut on NfProfile is a plausible maintainer addition

O8b_injection_room.sibling: DecodeNfProfile (unused mapstructure decoder) wired into a bulk/import or legacy register path that bypasses openapi.Deserialize and the raw-JSON check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the helper exists already and decodes map[string]interface{} into NfProfile, a natural building block for a legacy/admin import route

O9_family: CWE-20 improper input validation of stored NF profile (registry poisoning of service endpoints)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add field checks to NFRegisterProcedure on the decoded struct only, leaving PATCH (validated only on op paths) and the raw-JSON explicit-zero/negative heartBeatTimer case open.
